summary: Receives Stype/RedSpy camera tracking data over the Stype HF protocol and outputs virtual-camera transform, lens, timecode, and diagnostic channels.
key_concepts: Stype In CHOP is a TouchDesigner Pro operator for receiving Stype/RedSpy camera tracking data over the Stype HF protocol.
Its channels drive virtual-camera transforms, lens values, timecode, and Stype TOP lens-distortion workflows.
The connected channel reports whether valid Stype messages have arrived recently, while recording, focus_distance, and timecode channels mirror Stype Kit metadata.
Camera channels include tx/ty/tz, rx/ry/rz, fov, padded_fov, aspect, focus, zoom, sensor center, radial distortion, and sensor size values.
Info CHOP channels expose valid, unrecognized, corrupt, missing, and dropped packet counts plus the last packet number for network diagnosis.
Protocol, multicast address, network port, and local adapter settings must match the Stype hardware output; Padding expands FOV for distortion sampling outside the normal render area.

key_params.name: protocol
key_params.note: Messaging UDP, multicast messaging UDP, or reliable messaging UDT

key_params.name: localaddress
key_params.note: NIC/local adapter address for multi-adapter machines

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Receive packets on the configured port

key_params.name: padding
key_params.note: Increase FOV for lens-distortion sampling outside the normal render area

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as TouchDesigner Pro only.
Requires Stype hardware sending the Stype HF protocol.
While Active is off, no updating occurs and data sent to the port is lost.
Use Info CHOP to diagnose dropped or skipped packets.
Outputs camera tx/ty/tz, rx/ry/rz, FOV, padded FOV, aspect, focus, zoom, sensor-center, distortion, and sensor-size channels for Camera COMP and Stype TOP workflows.
Port, protocol, multicast address, and local adapter must match the hardware output settings.
Stype TOP uses the lens/sensor distortion channels for lens correction; keep CHOP/TOP configuration paired.
